core_types.name: Client
core_types.description: SSHv2 client connection managing multiplexed channels

core_types.name: Session
core_types.description: Remote command execution, subsystem, or interactive shell session

core_types.name: Channel
core_types.description: Full-duplex stream channel multiplexed over single SSH transport

concurrency_model.type: Multiplexed Full-Duplex Demuxer with Per-Channel Buffers
concurrency_model.synchronization: sync.Mutex on transport writer; condition variables for channel window size adjustments

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: Deadline set via net.Conn.SetDeadline(); Channel.Close() shuts down remote streams
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: Session.Close() releases channel resources and terminates reader goroutines

retry_model.strategy: Authentication retry up to configured ClientConfig.Auth methods

boundaries.network: Raw TCP network socket on port 22
boundaries.os: Terminal pseudo-TTY (PTY) modes and terminal window resize signals
boundaries.serialization: SSHv2 wire protocol packet encoding and cryptographic algorithms (ChaCha20, Ed25519, RSA)
